title: Xor over a list with a leading pair
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $x$ assign Boolean values to its variables, let $p$ be a pair of Boolean circuit trees on those variables, and let $P$ be a finite list of such pairs. The exclusive-or of the first circuit in each pair, accumulated over the list $p::P$ with false as the initial value, is the exclusive-or of the first circuit in $p$ with the corresponding accumulation over $P$.
hypotheses_covered: An assignment of Boolean values to the variables

A finite list of pairs of Boolean circuit trees $P$
